52class BackendRegistry {
53public:
55 using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
56
58 static constexpr Clock::duration DefaultTimeToLive = std::chrono::seconds(30);
59
61 BackendRegistry() = default;
62
68 explicit BackendRegistry(Clock::duration timeToLive);
69
83 bool insertOrRefresh(BackendWrapper backend,
84 Clock::time_point now = Clock::now());
85
90 std::size_t expire(Clock::time_point now = Clock::now());
91
99 [[nodiscard]] const BackendWrapper *find(std::string_view backendName) const;
100
104 [[nodiscard]] bool contains(std::string_view backendName) const;
105
108 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return entries.size(); }
109
112 [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const noexcept { return entries.empty(); }
113
116 [[nodiscard]] Clock::duration getTimeToLive() const noexcept {
117 return entryTimeToLive;
118 }
119
125 template <typename Fn> void forEachBackend(Fn &&fn) const {
126 for (const auto &[backendName, entry] : entries) {
127 std::invoke(fn, backendName, entry.backend);
128 }
129 }
130
131private:
132 struct Entry {
133 BackendWrapper backend;
134 Clock::time_point lastRefreshed;
135 };
136
137 // Ordered, so iteration -- and therefore selection -- is deterministic.
138 // std::less<> gives heterogeneous lookup from std::string_view without
139 // materialising a std::string per query.
140 std::map<std::string, Entry, std::less<>> entries;
141 Clock::duration entryTimeToLive{DefaultTimeToLive};
142};
